fortune.isekai_mahou.sakura.chukichi.tex: A good wind blows at your back.
fortune.isekai_mahou.sakura.daikichi.tex: The petals dance in your favor. Today everything blooms!
fortune.isekai_mahou.sakura.daikyo.text: A crow crossed your path... tie this slip at once!
fortune.isekai_mahou.sakura.kichi.text: Fortune smiles on those who keep going.
fortune.isekai_mahou.sakura.kyo.text: Clouds in the sky. Tie the slip at the shrine.
fortune.isekai_mahou.sakura.suekichi.tex: Nothing changes today... luck comes later.
item.isekai_mahou.sakura_fortune_slip.bl: Draw your fortune of the day at an Omikuji Box (Torii Shrine).
item.isekai_mahou.sakura_fortune_slip.cu: Bad luck! Use this slip on the Omikuji Box to tie it there and leave the misfortune behind.
item.isekai_mahou.sakura_fortune_slip.ke: Good fortune: keep it as a memento.
message.isekai_mahou.sakura.omikuji.alre: You already drew your fortune today. Come back tomorrow!
message.isekai_mahou.sakura.omikuji.hint: Leave an offering (gold nugget, emerald or guild coin) to draw your fortune of the day.
message.isekai_mahou.sakura.omikuji.keep: Good-luck slips are not tied: keep it with you!
message.isekai_mahou.sakura.omikuji.tie_: Tip: use the slip on the Omikuji Box to tie it and get rid of the misfortune.
message.isekai_mahou.sakura.omikuji.tied: You tied the slip at the shrine. The misfortune stays behind.
